eligibility_reason: Original research proposing Smoothing Complete Feature Pyramid Networks (SCFPN) and evaluating bounding box defect detection on NEU-DET.

F01.value: 1200 samples, 6 classes (Cr, In, RS, PS, Pa, Sc), 200x200 resolution
F01.evidence: such as NEU-Det (1200 samples with the resolution of 200 × 200), which is widely used among peers.

F05.value: ResNet101 backbone pre-trained on ImageNet for FPN series (FPN, CFPN, SCFPN); not specified for other baselines
F05.evidence: The FPN series networks (FPN, CFPN, and SCFPN) employ ResNet101 which pre-trained on ImageNet as backbones.

F09.value: 200x200 dataset image resolution stated and SCFPN accepts arbitrary single-scale size, but unclear if resized during training/testing
F09.evidence: In addition, the image resolution of DeepPCB and NEU datasets are 640 × 640 and 200 × 200, respectively.

F14.evidence: Experimental results from methods without “*” are rerun by ourselves, and experimental results from methods with “*” are cited from published papers.
